Seasonal components of the Cover sub-index

Source: R/shmi_components.R
compute_cover_components.Rd

Returns \(p_s\), the proportion of days of season \(s\) in the rotation that carry living plant cover. compute_cover() is \(100 \sum_s w_s p_s\) with the weights rescaled to sum to 1, so any set of season weights can be evaluated or estimated from this table.

Usage

compute_cover_components(crop, rot_bounds, clip_to_rotation = TRUE)

Arguments

crop

Species episodes with MGT_combo, CD_name, crop_start, crop_end.

rot_bounds

Rotation bounds with MGT_combo, rot_start, rot_end.

clip_to_rotation

Logical. If TRUE (recommended), only plant days inside rot_start-rot_end count, so \(0 \le p_s \le 1\). FALSE reproduces SHMI <= 1.1.0, which counted every plant day of an episode, including days outside the rotation, against the rotation's season lengths (so \(p_s\) could exceed 1).

Value

A tibble with MGT_combo, p_winter, p_spring, p_summer, p_fall, days_winter ... days_fall (days of each season in the rotation) and outside_days (plant days outside the rotation window), one row per unit in rot_bounds.

Details

Plant windows are all episodes except those named "fallow", "none" or "bare" (case- and whitespace-insensitive); overlapping windows are merged so each day counts once; seasons follow calendar months (winter Dec-Feb, spring Mar-May, summer Jun-Aug, fall Sep-Nov).
